properties.name: Dalhousie University
properties.location_note: Representative mapped university point at the Studley campus in Halifax. Dalhousie has several campuses; institution-wide source totals are not allocated to this campus or to individual award sites.

properties.name: Lakehead University
properties.location_note: Representative point for the mapped Thunder Bay campus. Lakehead also has an Orillia campus; institution-wide source totals are not allocated to Thunder Bay or to individual award sites.

properties.name: The University of British Columbia
properties.location_note: Representative OpenStreetMap point for the Point Grey campus lands. Vancouver is the source comparator and mailing label; the campus lies in Electoral Area A outside municipal Vancouver. Institution-wide source totals may include other campuses and affiliated sites and are not allocated to this point.

properties.name: University of Northern British Columbia
properties.location_note: Representative point for the mapped Prince George campus. UNBC has regional campuses and research facilities; source totals are institution-wide and do not identify a future NHHR building, participant location, or individual award site.

properties.name: University of Saskatchewan
properties.location_note: Representative point for the mapped Saskatoon university campus. Institution-wide source totals may include other locations, field facilities and affiliated research sites; they are not allocated to this point.

properties.name: NOSM University
properties.location_note: Point for the mapped Northern Ontario School of Medicine building at the Thunder Bay campus. NOSM University is distributed across Thunder Bay, Sudbury and partner communities. The source comparator labels Thunder Bay; institution-wide totals are not exclusively allocated to this campus.

properties.name: BC Cancer
properties.site: BC Cancer Research Centre · 675 West 10th Avenue
properties.location_note: Representative Vancouver research and administration site; OpenStreetMap names this building Leon Judah Blackmore Cancer Research Centre. BC Cancer operates across BC. Institution-wide source totals are not allocated to this building, Vancouver patients, or an individual clinical or award site.

properties.name: McMaster University
properties.location_note: Representative point inside the verified Hamilton main-campus feature. McMaster operates additional campuses and affiliated research sites. Institution-wide source totals are not allocated to this campus, its buildings, residents or individual projects.
